source: Book II printed p.11 = book2-3-4.pdf PDF p.17, image-read; ERRATA sheet p.1 (ER-05); Step 7 speculative derivation from topology
note: Step 7 speculative fixture (derivation A): every expect is derived by hand from the corrected 8-wire topology and the p.11 rule, tagged FALLBACK-DERIVED-TOPOLOGY. The page prints no numbered procedure, so the script is: power on, push and release pushbutton 1, push and release pushbutton 2, then hold pushbutton 1 and add pushbutton 2, releasing 1 before 2. Indicator lamp 1 is asserted only where it is dark, because a lit lamp in series with a coil has a profile-dependent class. Light 1 is wired straight across 1G and minus, so it is asserted on at full rail. The both-buttons case is not printed: it follows from 1C = 1G, which puts pushbutton 1's + on light 1 independent of the relay. Script choices, not printed: each push and release is followed by settle 500 ms and a 200 ms advance.

(1Y-1X) and relay 1 set-1 N.O. (1H-1G, the self-hold); relay 1 cold and out, so 1H-1G is open; pushbutton 1 up, so 1Y-1X is open; P1 has no + source: coil 1, indicator lamp 1 and light 1 unfed (remembering 0)
script.quote: Pushbutton 1 serves as the "forget 0 remember 1" signal and pushbutton 2 provides the "forget 1 remember 0" signal.
